node.statement: The cofactor-514 magnitude profile (E;n1,n2,n3)=(10;6,1,0) has nested-layer bound |M3|<=268 and signed relation divisibility M3=0 mod 6, hence M3<=264. A global cubic Hermite majorant puts its norm below the prize field floor. Twelve magnitude profiles remain.
node.notes: ANALYTIC REFINEMENT 2026-07-29: the six-divisibility of the signed cubic relation index supplies the four-unit improvement that the relaxed layer bound lacked. The five-ideal occupancy threshold remains open.
